SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, si.warehouse_org_id AS inventoryOrgId, sd.qty, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, si.warehouse_id FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE
AND si.id = #{id}
SELECT MAX(price) AS maxPrice, MIN(price) AS minPrice, sku_id, COUNT(sku_id) AS count, round( SUM ( price ) / COUNT ( sku_id ), 2 ) avgPrice FROM so_detail WHERE is_deleted=FALSE GROUP BY sku_id
